title: SEC1: HMAC key buffer too small for SHA-512
description:
Crypto2DevHmacCtx.key is declared as byte key[64], and crypto2dev_hmac_setkey_ctx() rejects keys longer than 64 bytes with BAD_FUNC_ARG.

HMAC-SHA512 uses a 128-byte block size (WC_SHA512_BLOCK_SIZE = 128). Raw HMAC keys up to 128 bytes are valid and must be accepted before the HMAC key-derivation step. Rejecting 65-128 byte keys with BAD_FUNC_ARG silently breaks HMAC-SHA512 for any caller that passes a key longer than 64 bytes.

Additionally, the magic numbers 32 and 64 should be replaced with named constants:
- key[32] in Crypto2DevAesCtx -> AES_256_KEY_SIZE
- key[64] in Crypto2DevHmacCtx -> WC_HMAC_BLOCK_SIZE (= 128 after fix)
- keySz > 32 guard -> keySz > AES_256_KEY_SIZE
- keySz > 64 guard -> keySz > WC_HMAC_BLOCK_SIZE

Fix: change key[64] to key[WC_HMAC_BLOCK_SIZE] and update the guard to keySz > WC_HMAC_BLOCK_SIZE.

Affected lines: crypto2dev_port.c:255, 969.
